copilot.title: Editing copilot
copilot.unavailable: The copilot couldn't assess this video's rhythm this time. The drop and the rewrites above still stand.

cuts.label: Suggested cuts
cuts.none: No cuts needed. The video is already tight.

measured.note: The AI was busy, so these cuts come from what we measured in the file itself: pauses in the audio and shots without a scene change.
measured.pace: {wps} words per second while speaking, {pause_pct}% of the video in pauses.
measured.summary: Start with the longest pause and the longest shot without a change: that's where people lose interest most easily.

why.dead_start: {seconds}s of silence before you start talking. Cut it and open straight on your first line.
why.dead_end: {seconds}s of silence at the end. Cut it so the video ends on your last line.
why.long_pause: {seconds}s pause. Shorten it to keep the rhythm.
why.static_shot: {seconds}s without a scene change. A zoom, a cut or b-roll here breaks the static shot.

reason.static_shot: {seconds}s in the same shot, with no change.

plan.label: Editing action plan
plan.lead: {done} of {count} done. In order of impact: the first one changes the most.

dead_start.title: Cut the {seconds}s of silence at the start
dead_start.action: Trim the video so it starts on your first word. The opening seconds decide who stays.

dead_end.title: Cut the {seconds}s of silence at the end
dead_end.action: End the video on the last word. Dead air at the end pulls the average watch time down.

long_pause.title: Shorten the {seconds}s pause
long_pause.action: Cut the silence down to about 0.3s, or speed up that stretch.

static_shot.title: Break the {seconds}s in the same shot
static_shot.action: Add a cut, a zoom or a B-roll here: the frame hasn't changed for too long.

manus.title: Send this plan to Manus
manus.lead: Manus turns the plan into an executable edit list: the order to work in, the caption and CTA copy written out, and what to film for each B-roll. Your video stays here — Manus gets the plan, not the file.
manus.where: Create a key in your Manus account, under API keys:
manus.credits: Runs on your Manus account, using your credits.

hero.eyebrow: For people who shoot and edit their own Reels
hero.title: Your Reels lose people at one exact second. Publishub shows you which, and what to say instead.
hero.lead: Send the video. In about 3 minutes, Publishub points to the second your audience left, the line you were saying at that moment, and three rewrites ready to re-record. The retention screenshot from Insights is optional: with it, the curve is your real one.
hero.note: Video up to 50 MB · result in about 3 minutes
hero.marginalia: At {time}, {lost}% of people left while you were saying:
hero.samplePhrase: So, before anything else, let me give you some quick context on why I decided to do this.
hero.sampleNote: A real analysis, as an example. The curve comes from your screenshot; the line, from your video's transcript.

moments.title: One video, one drop, about 3 minutes

one.title: You send
one.text: The Reel exactly as published and the retention curve screenshot from Insights. If you like, tell us what you thought would keep people watching: the AI uses it in the comparison.

two.title: You find the second and the line
two.text: Publishub transcribes the video, reads the curve in the screenshot and aligns the two. You get the exact second of the drop and the line you were saying at it. Not a guess about the hook. The literal cause.

three.title: You re-record only the right part
three.text: Three ways to say the same thing without losing people who just arrived, each with the why. The editing copilot comes along as a second read: pace, dead stretches and where to cut.

moments.sampleRewrite: On day 12 I almost quit. Here's what happened to my sleep.
moments.sampleWhy: Opens with a concrete moment and promises the payoff in the next line.

loop.title: A prediction you can check in Insights
loop.text1: Every "improve your hook" tip is impossible to verify. Publishub commits: it points to the second of the drop and predicts how much retention should rise after you re-record.
loop.text2: You republish, open Insights and paste the real number. It hit, or it didn't. Over time you build an accuracy score and learn what works with your audience, not everyone else's.
loop.sampleVerdict: Confirmed: the real number landed {diff} points above the prediction.

offer.title: Pay once. Use it forever.
offer.lead: No subscription, no monthly fee. It costs less than one boosted post and, unlike a boost, it fixes the video instead of just pushing it.

faq.title: Before you send the first video
faq.q1: What do I need to send?
faq.a1: Just the Reel's video file (MP4, MOV or WEBM, up to 50 MB). If you also send the retention screenshot from Instagram Insights, Publishub uses your real curve and gives you a prediction you can check.
faq.a2: Publishub needs a video with speech and a readable retention chart. TikTok shows that curve in its video analytics too; if the screenshot is clear, it works the same way.
faq.a3: No. It's a one-time payment with lifetime access, no monthly fee and no renewal. Every improvement Publishub gets, you get.

Landing.footer: Made for people who edit their own videos and want to stop losing viewers at the same second.

Plans.title: Pay once. Use it forever.
Plans.lead: Every Reel you publish is losing people at some second. For less than one boosted post, you find out which one and fix it, in this video and every one after.
